content.hypothesis: Prioritizing inspection of closed storage receptacles (drawers/cabinets) over open surfaces (countertops/shelves) reduces total navigation steps by avoiding redundant visits to empty open areas, assuming the target is more likely to be hidden inside a container.
content.realization_pattern: Filter candidate receptacles by type: prioritize 'closed storage' types (e.g., drawers, cabinets, fridges) over 'open surface' types (e.g., countertops, shelves). Within the prioritized group, select the nearest or first-listed instance.
content.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object is not immediately visible and multiple candidate receptacles are present in the initial observation.
